rules.identification: Any Uratha touching a fetish or talen immediately senses its spiritual power. With time to study it, Intelligence + Occult identifies its general nature.
rules.creation: The Fetish Rite binds a spirit into a physical object. A fetish's one-to-five-dot rating represents the bound spirit's Rank and the item's power. Spirits may negotiate willing service or be forcibly bound; repeatedly fueling a forced binding with Essence can eventually let the spirit escape. Fetishes are obtained through the story, bargaining or ritual creation, not through a Fetish Merit in this book.
rules.fetishActivation: Normally roll Resolve + Composure minus the fetish's dot rating, or spend 1 Essence instead of rolling. Follow any requirements or exceptions in the individual item's effect.
rules.talenCreation: A talen stores one to five dots of spiritual power. It can be made with a rite, by a spirit investing part of itself (suffering lethal damage equal to the talen's rating), or rarely by an object naturally gathering strong Resonance.
rules.talenActivation: An Uratha needs no roll to activate a talen. It expends its power after one use. An Influence takes an instant action; a Facet uses its listed instant or reflexive action.
rules.talenFacet: A talen containing a Facet lets the Uratha use that Facet as if known, substituting the talen's rating for Renown when determining its effects. A permanent Facet lasts only one scene. This does not teach the Facet or unlock its Gift.
rules.talenInfluence: A talen containing an Influence grants its use for one scene at a rating equal to the talen's dots. Use Presence + Wits instead of Power + Finesse.

ratings.effect: Minor or specialized effects: a small conditional dice bonus, one or two Specialties, Influence 1 (possibly 2 for a niche use), or a simple utility such as a lock that destroys lockpicks.
Useful effects: a minor weapon benefit such as a Tilt on the first strike, +3 to a particular Facet's pool, or a technological function improved by adding the rating to its equipment modifier.
Potent effects: modest improvements to a whole vehicle, +3 Handling or favorable traffic lights, substantial movement limited to the Shadow, Influence 3, or a new way to use a specific Facet.
Very powerful or broad effects: a major weapon enhancement, roughly +3 and 9-again on Social maneuvers, or +3 Defense and contested pools against certain spirits.

Legendary effects: weapons harming Essence or Willpower as well as flesh, 8-again and rote quality on particular pools, major benefits to an entire Gift, or exceptional rule-breaking such as Defense against mental attacks or counting as an unusual bane.

items.name: Witch-Poppet
items.description: A small charm or doll used by wilderness packs to delay intruders; after activation, hang it from a tree or bush.
items.effect: The first person to touch the activated poppet is affected by the Knotted Paths Facet of the Gift of Nature.

items.name: Dawn Shard
items.description: A sigil-carved fragment of mirror carried when dealing with unpredictable sun spirits.
items.effect: Every Helion the Uratha encounters improves its first impression by one level while it can see the shard on the Uratha's person.

items.name: Stalker's Lament
items.description: A necklace or choker, popular with Irraka away from their packs, that responds to its wearer's howl.
items.effect: All other werewolves in the pack hear the howl clearly regardless of distance, and know the howler's direction and distance. It conveys no further information; packs often arrange an emergency signal in advance.

items.name: Tracker's Lantern
items.description: A small lamp or torch burning with an unusual violet light.
items.effect: Handprints and footprints made within the last hour shimmer visibly wherever its light falls.

items.name: Charred Death-Rattle
items.description: A charm of scorched bone that clatters when shaken, common among Bone Shadows.
items.effect: Use it while activating Tongue of Flame from the Gift of Elemental to add +3 to the Uratha's Influence (Fire) pool.

items.name: Devourer's Fang
items.description: A gnarled tooth that must painfully replace one of the Uratha's own teeth.
items.effect: In any hybrid form, the Uratha's mouth fills with grinding teeth that can chew any material, including stone, concrete and metal. Anything eaten provides sustenance regardless of its actual value as food.

items.name: Rust-Talon Bindings
items.description: Heavy chain manacles covered in reddish-brown corrosion.
items.effect: A bound target takes 1 lethal damage whenever attempting a supernatural power, then must win a Clash of Wills against the fetish's pool of 5. Unchained Strength is the sole exception and works normally. Tools or weapons used to break or pick the bindings suffer 1 Structure damage, ignoring Durability.

items.name: Dragon's Egg Bezoar
items.description: A rough lump swallowed painfully; it radiates invigorating heat once in the stomach.
items.effect: Consuming the bezoar activates Primal Strength from the Gift of Strength.

items.name: Brine Bottle
items.description: Used by coastal werewolves to reshape the Heart of Water Facet.
items.effect: An Uratha who possesses Heart of Water from the Gift of Elemental may leap into seawater and spend 1 Essence to breathe underwater for the scene instead of using Influence (Water).

items.name: Gridlock Puzzle
items.description: A mesh of interlocking metal rings and squares that can be pulled and rearranged.
items.effect: An Uratha who possesses All Doors Locked from the Gift of Warding may use the puzzle to control traffic lights and other traffic-control systems instead of doors and windows, within 100 yards × Honor Renown.

items.name: Steel Wolf
items.description: A solidly built car or van used by some modern packs, especially those including Iron Masters.
items.effect: The vehicle has one of the printed variants below.

variants.name: Road Shadow
variants.effect: When activated, its engine and wheels make no noise.

variants.name: Ironhide
variants.effect: Its Durability increases by +3 against attackers.

items.name: Whisper Knife
items.description: A knife capable of striking beings in Twilight; it does not itself let the wielder see them.
items.effect: The Uratha can attack Twilight entities with the blade. On a successful hit, it whispers the wounded being's nature into the wielder's mind.

items.name: Storm Coil
items.description: An unusual copper or iron lamp containing a metal coil.
items.effect: Grants Influence (Electricity) 3, commonly used to overload a building's power supply with a surge or ground a live system so the Uratha can tamper with it.

items.name: Crimson Falx
items.description: A brutal curved blade sharpened on its inner edge, usually a glaive or sickle, most often wielded by Blood Talons or Storm Lords.
items.effect: After activation, the first enemy struck in a scene permanently suffers Arm Wrack or Leg Wrack (attacker's choice): the weapon severs the limb.

items.name: Shadow Thunderhead Mask
items.description: A mask portraying a snarling Uratha or spirit, intimidating spirits attempting subtle magic against the wearer.
items.effect: Add Presence to all pools resisting Influence, Numina or Dread Powers from spirits or Claimed, except actual physical attacks.

items.name: Sky-Caller Trinket
items.description: A bundle of feathers and bird bones tied together with brightly colored thread.
items.effect: Grants Influence (Birds) 4, allowing uses such as conjuring loyal birds or controlling nearby flocks.

items.name: Cuneiform Cylinder
items.description: A clay cylinder bearing First Tongue claw-sigils that recount Forsaken history. Rare ancient examples may come from the First Pack.
items.effect: Reading its exterior activates This Story Is True from the Gift of Knowledge. A rare cylinder made by the First Pack may have an even greater effect; the book supplies no additional fixed value.

items.name: Drum of the Heavens
items.description: A sizeable drum whose deep, beautiful notes evoke creation's music and draw spirits' attention.
items.effect: For each minute a spirit that is not outright hostile listens, its impression of the drummer improves one level. Spirits may relentlessly pester the owner to hear the drum again.
